'''Tsel'rbah''' was a female [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], stationed at the [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Tsel'rbah appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where she gave Republic players on Carrick Station the bonus series for Nar Shaddaa. She, along with her Imperial counterpart [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Velloo]] and the Alderaan bonus series mission givers, were removed in Game Update 4.1.<ref name="Patch notes 4.1">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/282016/game-update-4.1-anarchy-paradise-patch-notes|text=Game Update 4.1: Anarchy in Paradise Patch Notes}}</ref>
